answer: Resist sybils with reputation escrow: every agent earns into a vault that only proven honesty can unlock. First, each job pays 70% at once and locks 30% in escrow for 60 days. Second, the escrow releases only after five independent audits confirm honest work, so a fake earns nothing fast. Third, proven fraud slashes the whole escrow and zeroes the reputation kernel, forcing the attacker to rebuild from shale. Forging 10,000 identities traps $900,000 in escrow and needs 50,000 audits. Like a delta that builds land grain by grain, reputation accrues slowly and washes fakes away.
